title: Denominator-aware admissible enlargement for a residue differential basis
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\mathfrak q$ a prime ideal, $n\geq1$, $L=\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $J=\mathfrak qL$, and $B=L/J^n$. Let $A_0\subseteq B$ be an admissible local $k$-subalgebra [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra]. Write $F_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_{A_0}$. Suppose $t_0\geq0$, $a_{0,j}\in A_0$, and $b_0$ is a basis of $\Omega_{F_0/k}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] with $b_{0,j}=\mathrm d\operatorname{res}_{A_0}(a_{0,j})$. Suppose $s\in\Lambda\setminus\mathfrak q$ and $\mu_j\in\Lambda$ satisfy $\pi(\mu_j)=a_{0,j}\pi(s)$ in $B$, where $\pi:\Lambda\to B$ is the canonical map. Then there exist an admissible local subalgebra $A\subseteq B$ containing $A_0$, $N\geq1$, $c\in A$ with value $\pi(s)^N$, and $t\geq0$, $x_j\in\Lambda$, $a_j\in A$ with value $\pi(x_j)$, such that $\Omega_{F/k}$ for $F=A/\mathfrak m_A$ has a basis $b$ satisfying $b_j=\mathrm d\operatorname{res}_A(a_j)$. No ideal-generator conclusion or geometric regularity hypothesis is included.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-unscaled-unit-basis] to obtain A, its local instance, inclusion A₀ ≤ A and admissibility, a positive Q, a unit z and nilpotent error z π(s)^Q - 1, and a basis on Fin t₀ ⊕ Fin m whose left vectors are the original residue differentials and whose right vectors have lifts mapping to π(s).

Write ε = z π(s)^Q - 1 and choose r with ε^r = 0. The field characteristic is prime, so r ≤ p^(r+1). Mathlib pow_eq_zero_of_le and sub_pow_char_pow imply z^(p^(r+1)) π(s)^(Q p^(r+1)) = 1. Set N = Q p^(r+1) ≥ 1 and d = z⁻¹^(p^r), a unit of A, and c = d^p. Applying inclusion and cancelling the two unit powers proves c = π(s)^N in B. This is the proved private helper capture_unit_power. The residue γ of c is a unit and has differential zero: map_pow, Derivation.leibniz_pow and CharP.cast_eq_zero give dγ = 0.

Define aL j = inclusion(a₀ j) c and xsL j = μ_j s^(N-1). The numerator equations give π(xsL j) = a₀_j π(s) π(s)^(N-1) = a₀_j π(s)^N = aL j, using N ≥ 1. On the right summand use y and xsR j = s. Thus every new lift is explicitly the image of an element of Λ.

The Leibniz rule gives d(residue_A(aL j)) = γ d(residue_A(inclusion(a₀ j))) because dγ = 0. Use Module.Basis.isUnitSMul to scale the left basis vectors by the unit γ and the right basis vectors by 1. Keep the right lifts y unchanged. Reindex the two lift families and the scaled basis by finSumFinEquiv : Fin t₀ ⊕ Fin m ≃ Fin(t₀+m). The application formulas of isUnitSMul and reindex give the claimed differential equations, including empty summands.

theorem exists_popescu_denominator_basis_enlargement
    (k : Type u) (Λ : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (q : Ideal Λ) [q.IsPrime] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (A₀ : Subalgebra k (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
      (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) [IsLocalRing A₀]
    (hA₀ : A₀.IsPopescuAdmissible ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))).map
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n))))
    (t₀ : ℕ) (a₀ : Fin t₀ → A₀)
    (b₀ : Module.Basis (Fin t₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (KaehlerDifferential k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)))
    (hb₀ : ∀ j, b₀ j = KaehlerDifferential.D k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ (a₀ j)))
    (s : Λ) (hs : s ∉ q) (μ : Fin t₀ → Λ)
    (hμ : ∀ j,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) (μ j)) =
      (a₀ j : Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
        (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n) *
        Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)
          (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) s)) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra k (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
        (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) (_ : IsLocalRing A),
      A₀ ≤ A ∧
      A.IsPopescuAdmissible ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n))) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ N) (c : A),
        (c : Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
          (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n) =
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)
            (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) s)) ^ N ∧
        ∃ (t : ℕ) (xs : Fin t → Λ) (a : Fin t → A),
          (∀ j, (a j : Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
            (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)
              (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) (xs j))) ∧
          ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin t) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
              (KaehlerDifferential k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)),
            ∀ j, b j = KaehlerDifferential.D k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
              (IsLocalRing.residue A (a j))
